Assembles and validates the portable CE issue catalog while preserving locale error text.
Enums define stable domain and general error codes.
Constructs portable catalog-backed CE errors with logical locations and preserved domain metadata.
Formats safe catalog messages, remediation guidance and logical descriptor locations.

Owns normalized remediation guidance for portable CE errors.
Publishes the portable descriptor location value without runtime imports.
Tracks logical descriptor identity within explicit context-local scopes.
Defines serializable logical descriptor locations without filesystem access.
Defines narrow structural protocols for descriptor metadata consumed by error formatting.

Owns portable condition evaluation issue definitions and their canonical guidance.

Owns portable descriptor inclusion issue definitions and their canonical guidance.

components.label: codes
forbidden_responsibilities: Select validation policy or depend on Runtime settings.

components.label: base
responsibilities: Keep DomainError and InvalidLocaleError identities, payloads and pickle behavior; add portable ValueError/RuntimeError types with code, issue, cause and location.
forbidden_responsibilities: Open resources or import concrete clients.

requires.rationale: Error types carry codes without runtime policy.
Portable error types carry logical descriptor location values.

components.label: catalog
responsibilities: Own portable issue definitions, E/I/W code templates and default guidance; no backend classification.
forbidden_responsibilities: Inspect runtime state or implement validation policy.

requires.rationale: Definitions refer to the canonical shared E/I/W vocabulary and CE keeps DomainErrorCode in codes.py.

components.label: formatters
forbidden_responsibilities: Choose recovery policy or change error codes.

requires.rationale: Formatters use the canonical message text.
Messages render logical descriptor identities without host paths.

components.label: factory
responsibilities: Construct user errors from typed facts and emit catalog warnings with process-local deduplication; preserve CE locale/domain metadata.
forbidden_responsibilities: Catch vendor exceptions or decide whether a condition is an error.

requires.rationale: Factories attach logical locations and explicit descriptor metadata.
Warning factories use canonical definitions and severity.

components.label: context
responsibilities: Own immutable logical descriptor identities, locations and structural carrier protocols.
forbidden_responsibilities: Open files, inspect Runtime objects dynamically or import backend drivers.

rules.rationale: Every child implementation and the package-level error facade has one declared owner.
Only the listed responsibility directions are permitted.
A dependency reaches explicit operations and types, not arbitrary implementation details.
Lower layers do not import their consumers.
Canonical error message text. Exact reviewed target children; no hidden extra modules.
Exact reviewed portable metadata, error-context or contract-export modules; no implicit extra files.
